nonBlockingFollowups: P01 stays closed until G00 is accepted; this ZIP is not a portable product or installer.
The manifest intentionally records absolute local tool paths, including the Python installation path; README now discloses this and states the ZIP is not portable.

recommendation.rationale: The final ZIP contains only the three declared research-candidate files, and the code/README member hashes match its manifest. The final independent fresh extraction passed smoke, no-key, no-dsh, and offline cases with zero paid calls. The evidence distinguishes mock behavior, a missing DSH entry override, and a loopback-only connection failure from real-provider availability, DSH-source absence, or system-wide offline guarantees.

findings.result: Direct .NET ZipArchive inspection found exactly candidate.py, README.md, and manifest.json. Their sizes and hashes match the final manifest and workspace files. The manifest enumerates fixed external project/source/toolchain dependencies; no third-party source, runtime binary, role asset, or real credential is embedded. The local tool-path disclosure is explicit in the revised README.

The manifest pins ZCode, DSH, and Herta and binds required external files by hash. The external-project fixture uses three Windows junction aliases to those fixed trees; they are not ACL protection. Candidate logic reads and checks source pins and writes case evidence outside those trees. The ZIP has no third-party payload and makes no downstream distribution-rights claim; future product dependencies, notices, and role rights remain separate release gates.

The final root run used a fresh extraction and all four cases passed with limits: smoke reran the U11 integration; no-key exercised only the mock path with a synthetic fake-key field and left real-model availability NOT_RUN; no-dsh checked only an absent entry override and did not launch or preflight DSH; offline recorded a failed TCP attempt to a closed loopback port (TimeoutError) and read back diagnostic state. The latter is not an OS-wide network block or provider fallback. All cases report zero paid calls.

P00 version 0.0.0 remains a local research candidate. Persona/Life schemas and role assets are NOT_PRESENT_IN_P00, approvedAssets is empty, P01 is not opened, and the 28 final product Musts are not marked complete. Product UI/runtime, installer/Windows package, real provider operation, final backup/restore, and product distribution rights are NOT_RUN or future-stage work, not evidence of a product release.
